export const COMMUNITY_WAITLIST_COPY = {
  body: "A way to compare notes with people whose plants also keep almost dying.",
  emailLabel: "Email",
  emailPlaceholder: "you@email.com",
  submitLabel: "Sign me up",
  submitting: "Sending…",
  successHeadline: "You're on the list.",
  successBody: "We’ll email when Community lands.",
  errorHeadline: "Couldn't save that.",
  errorBody: "Check the address and try again.",
  retryLabel: "Try again",
} as const;

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+create extension if not exists "pgcrypto";
+
+create table public.community_waitlist (
+  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
+  email text not null,
+  user_id uuid references auth.users (id) on delete set null,
+  source text not null check (source in ('web', 'ios')),
+  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
+);
+
+create unique index community_waitlist_email_source_uidx
+  on public.community_waitlist (lower(email), source);
+
+alter table public.community_waitlist enable row level security;
+
+create policy community_waitlist_insert_anon
+  on public.community_waitlist for insert to anon with check (true);
+
+create policy community_waitlist_insert_authenticated
+  on public.community_waitlist for insert to authenticated with check (true);
+
+create policy community_waitlist_service_all
+  on public.community_waitlist for all to service_role using (true) with check (true);
